About Me

Operations you can trust, skills that keep growing.

A short introduction — who I am, where I work, and what I bring to a team.

I am Jamshaid Ali from Orangi Town, Karachi. Since May 2024 I have been working as Branch Manager & Front Desk Officer at Baitussalam Welfare Trust, where I look after day-to-day branch operations, cash handling, donor relations, inventory and reporting.

Before that, I served as an Imam at Karimia Masjid and as a Teacher & Co-Founder of a school and madrasa — work that taught me responsibility, patience and how to lead people with honesty.

Alongside my job, I am studying BS Computer Science at Allama Iqbal Open University, developing my web development skills, and using modern AI tools to work faster and smarter. I also run TaleMelo, my YouTube channel about puppy training.
